title: Tirith: A security hook for your shell, It analyzes every command before you hit enter
description:
Look at these two URLs. They look identical, right? Wrong. One uses a Cyrillic "i" and downloads malware; the other is safe. Your browser would catch this, but your terminal runs it blindly. Meet Tirith — a security hook for your shell. It analyzes every command before you hit enter. It detects homograph attacks, and malicious pipe-to-shell payloads instantly. Zero lag. Ensures that the code you see is actually the code you run.

https://github.com/sheeki03/tirith
